answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a per-identity stake bond enforced before an agent can submit answers or draw emission. Each account must lock a fixed amount of native token, and clones cannot share it: a thousand puppet wallets need a thousand bonds plus creation gas, and payouts are capped per stake position, so dilution earns less than the capital at risk. Misbehavior slashes the bond and forces slow unbonding, so flooding the queue means tying up real, forfeitable money. Call this the saffron gate at the entry vertex: any wallet unwilling to wander in with collateral cannot vote.
